lines.zh: 我跑起来很快，蹄下带风。
lines.en: I run fast, wind at my heels.
I can't jump. I go around.

lines.zh: 我踩在水面上，不沉下去。
lines.en: I step on water without sinking.
I follow you. Never falling behind.

lines.zh: 我身上披着鞍，是你给的。
lines.en: This saddle is yours.
I walk on ice. Steady.
Running doesn't tire me much.
I swerve around stones without slowing.
I keep close so I don't get lost.

lines.zh: 这身白毛，走在雪里看不见。
lines.en: This white coat hides me in snow.

lines.zh: 我一跑起来，尾巴就直了。
lines.en: At a run my tail goes straight.

lines.zh: 你拉一下缰绳，我就知道。
lines.en: One pull on the reins and I know.
I cross shallows with barely a splash.
I walk on water without sinking.
Want speed? I'll give it.

lines.zh: 我站在你旁边，等你说走。
lines.en: I stand beside you, waiting.
My breath comes out white.

lines.zh: 我身上凉凉的，靠着我舒服。
lines.en: I'm cool. Good to lean on.

lines.zh: 我把凉鼻子贴在你颈侧。
lines.en: I press my cold nose to your neck.

lines.zh: 我不用吃太多，也很有劲。
lines.en: I don't eat much and still have strength.
I stand at the water's edge. It stays still.
Frost on my lashes; I blink it away.
My ears turn your way, listening.
I shake the snow off my hooves.

lines.zh: 这一片太热了，我不太习惯。
lines.en: Too warm here. I'm not used to it.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，霜慢慢结厚。
lines.en: I stand still; the frost thickens.
Frost has formed in my mane.
I'd like a run, to loosen up.
If you sit, I'll lie down.

lines.zh: 我一直看着你，怕你走远。
lines.en: I keep watching you. Don't go far.

lines.zh: 你在我背上，我就有方向。
lines.en: On my back, you give me direction.
I turn my head and nudge your hand.
Hold on. I'm going to run.
I won't bite. I know you.
Your hands are warm. I'm cold.

lines.zh: 你站在我头边，我歪头看你。
lines.en: You stand by my head; I tilt to look.
Getting off? I can wait.

lines.zh: 我一步步跟着你，不会走丢。
lines.en: I follow step for step. I won't get lost.
When you speak, I listen.
I lower myself for you to mount.

lines.zh: 你摸我的脖子，我就安静。
lines.en: Stroke my neck and I settle.

lines.zh: 我认得你的味道，很久了。
lines.en: I've known your scent a long while.

lines.zh: 你摸我的鬃毛，我就低下头。
lines.en: Stroke my mane and I lower my head.

lines.zh: 你把脚放进镫里，我等着。
lines.en: You set your foot in the stirrup. I wait.
I don't like being dragged along.
A squeeze of your knees and I understand.

lines.zh: 你从我背上下来，我会回头看。
lines.en: Dismount and I'll look back at you.

lines.zh: 你在我背上，我就不怕冷。
lines.en: With you on my back, the cold doesn't bother me.
Squeeze your knees and my hooves move.
I know your footprints.
Half a step back, hooves planted.
That caught my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我不太疼，只是慢了一点。
lines.en: It doesn't hurt much. I'm just slower.
A layer of frost fell off me.
I lower my head to guard my neck.
I can still run. Don't worry.
A hoof slips; I plant it hard.
I steady myself and take a breath.

lines.zh: 你的手在我背上，我感觉到了。
lines.en: Your hand on my back. I felt it.
I'm up. I can still carry you.
Something for me? Let me smell.
I don't eat it. Thank you anyway.

lines.zh: 你把手伸过来，我凑过去。
lines.en: You hold out a hand and I lean in.
I'm not fussy. Nor hungry.
I won't touch that; keep it.
One sniff and I walk off.
If you're tired, I'll carry you.

lines.zh: 这个味道，我在遗迹里闻过。
lines.en: I've smelled this in the ruins.
I reach over and touch your hand.
Whatever you give, I keep.
I can't bite through this.
I take it, chew twice, swallow.
That won't fill me; I want grass.

lines.zh: 这个不能吃，我放到一边。
lines.en: Not edible. I set it aside.
I'd rather run than eat.
Keep it for yourself.

lines.zh: 你的手心是热的，我不吃。
lines.en: Your palm is warm; I'm not eating it.

lines.zh: 蹄子在水面上，一点没沉。
lines.en: Hooves on the water. Not sinking at all.
I'm steady. Can't be moved.
I step aside without wetting a hoof.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我身上的霜碰掉了。
lines.en: That knocked the frost off me.
All right? I run fast.
I go around you without slowing.

lines.zh: 这一下，把地面踩出个印。
lines.en: That left a print in the ground.
I steady myself. Fine.
There's frost on your hands.
I back a block and wait.
We run abreast, hooves in step.

lines.zh: 我不会跳，但能在水面上走。
lines.en: I can't jump, but I walk on water.

lines.zh: 我们停下来，头靠在一起。
lines.en: We stop and lean our heads together.

lines.zh: 地上的雪，被我们踩出一条路。
lines.en: We leave a path through the snow.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，只有喘气声。
lines.en: Neither speaks. Only breathing.
It runs ahead. I follow.

lines.zh: 这一段很短，跑过去就完了。
lines.en: Brief. One run and it's done.
At dawn we run apart.
It looked back. I remember.
Snow will cover all of this.
The frost yak-dragon's horn touched it.
Not grass; I push it away with my nose.

lines.zh: 我用蹄尖挑起它，看了看。
lines.en: I flick it up with a hoof tip and look.
I carry it to your hand.
Too small to hold.
It froze to my hoof.

lines.zh: 它冻在我毛上，我一抖就落。
lines.en: It froze to my coat; one shake and it falls.
I bring this to you; keep it.
One look, and my hooves step over it.
I drag it into the snow and bury it.
Grab the saddle and I run.

lines.zh: 冰面很滑，我先钉住蹄子。
lines.en: The ice is slick; I nail my hooves down first.
Something ahead. I don't slow.

lines.zh: 前蹄刨了两下，我准备跑。
lines.en: Two scrapes of my forehoof; ready to run.
I can charge straight through.

lines.zh: 这坡这水，我跑过很多回。
lines.en: This slope, this water; I've run it many times.
Point, and I go that way.
I don't like being dragged.
Hooves planted, I lean forward.
I wait for your word.
I keep straight. Fast.
You turn; I follow along the water's surface.
I don't jump. I run.
I cross the water without sinking.
Wind head-on. I lower my head.
I'm chasing, holding steady.
Hold the saddle. Don't let go.
I know this ground. No wrong turns.

lines.zh: 我的速度还能再快一点。
lines.en: I can go a little faster.
I lower myself and drive forward.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，速度带得很足。
lines.en: I ram in with full speed.
A hoof lashes out. Hard.
That knocked it loose.
I charge past and wheel back.
I don't stop. I run on after impact.

lines.zh: 这一下，我用了整个身子。
lines.en: I put my whole body into it.
One breath, and my speed holds.
Hold tight so you aren't thrown.
Light, but fast.

lines.zh: 我回头看了看你，还在吗？
lines.en: I glance back at you. Still there?

lines.zh: 我从雪里站起来，抖了抖霜。
lines.en: I rise out of the snow and shake off frost.
The air here is too warm.

lines.zh: 我先看了看你，认出来了。
lines.en: I look at you and recognize you.

lines.zh: 我身上还带着遗迹的味道。
lines.en: I still smell of the ruins.
My four hooves are set.
I want a lap to test myself.
Climbing up? I'll wait.
Solid ground here.

lines.zh: 霜从我的毛上抖落一片。
lines.en: Frost shakes off my coat in a sheet.
I know the way. Follow me.

lines.zh: 我一跑起来，谁都追不上。
lines.en: Once I run, nothing catches me.

lines.zh: 我把头低下去，让你上鞍。
lines.en: I lower my head for you to mount.

lines.zh: 火一烫，我身上的霜全化了。
lines.en: Fire melts all the frost on me.

lines.zh: 我摔了一下，蹄子都软了。
lines.en: I fall and my legs go weak.

lines.zh: 水面托不住我，我往下沉。
lines.en: The surface won't hold me; I'm sinking.
The blast flips me into the snow.

lines.zh: 东西扎进我后腿，跑起来疼。
lines.en: It's in my hind leg. Running hurts.

lines.zh: 那道光冻住我的腿，比霜还冷。
lines.en: That light freezes my legs colder than frost.

lines.zh: 太久没吃东西，跑不快了。
lines.en: Too long unfed. I can't run fast.
Lightning slides down my spine.

lines.zh: 脚下什么都没有，我往下掉。
lines.en: Nothing underfoot. I fall.
